versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Biomedical Patent Trends skill.
- Enables download, search, and analysis of Patent-Mol-Wiki biomedical-patent packages.
- Supports trend statistics, portfolio queries, and entity lookups (targets, diseases, modalities, organizations, patents) using index.md files.
- Provides capabilities for patent distribution charts and molecular-structure analysis within selected patent folders.
- Emphasizes reproducibility, completeness caveats, and credential safety.
- Includes detailed reporting and charting guidance for portfolio and trend summaries.
